querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      ema_5d,
                                      ema2_5d,
                                      ema3_5d,
                                      ema_10d,
                                      ema2_10d,
                                      ema3_10d,
                                      ema_20d,
                                      ema_60d,
                                      ema_120d,
                                      ema_12d,
                                      ema_26d,
                                      ema_13d,
                                      s_pvi,
                                      s_nvi,
                                      s_tr,
                                      s_atr6,
                                      s_atr14,
                                      s_dbcd,
                                      s_ema3d,
                                      s_ema10d,
                                      s_ahl,
                                      s_bhl,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_indexmobilitybackright.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.indexmobilitybackright WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
